can.label: Which model can be rotated into the original?
can.observed: Rotations preserve adjacency and handedness. Same-sized mirrors can be inequivalent.
can.construct: Design a connected, visible asymmetric bend; vary the coordinates and the viewing pose. Keep a same-count foil which fails every proper rotation.

cannot.label: Which model cannot be obtained by rotation?
cannot.observed: A missing terminal cube invalidates the transformation; the remaining accepted alternatives can have different poses.
cannot.construct: Choose a terminal removal that stays connected and visible; keep both legal rotations. Vary the size and stance so the missing end can be identified in the single supplied view.
